rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a true lily flower.

example.english: I planted a lily in the flowerpot at home.
example.traditional: 我屋企個花盆種咗百合花。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 go3 faa1 pun4 zung3 zo2 baak3 hap6 faa1

rows.note: Use this only for a fleur-de-lis or other heraldic lily emblem, not an ordinary flower.

example.english: There is a lily emblem on this badge.
example.traditional: 呢個徽章上面有個百合花飾。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fai1 zoeng1 soeng6 min6 jau5 go3 baak3 hap6 faa1 sik1
